newsitem.title: JAPAN: HOSIDEN IN TALKS WITH PHILIPS ON LCD PROD.
newsitem.headline: HOSIDEN IN TALKS WITH PHILIPS ON LCD PROD.

text.p: Hosiden Corp said on Friday that it is in the final stage of negotiations with Philips Electronics NV on a tie-up to produce liquid crystal displays (LCDs).
A Hosiden official declined to give details.
Hosiden makes parts for consumer electronics products.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday that the two companies had already agreed to jointly produce LCDs in Japan.
They will form a joint venture next April and use Hosiden's existing plants to jointly produce LCDs, the paper said.
